meta_description:
1,190 likes, 17 comments - cntraveler on October 28, 2026: "Commerce writer @jeschapel's favorite @airbnb is a Hudson Valley retreat with a creekside hot tub and sauna:

"Getting 12 people to agree on a weekend away is an exercise in logistics. Someone wants to hike; someone else would rather browse antique shops; a few people are already asking what’s for dinner. My ideal group getaway? One that leaves room for all of it, with a house you're excited to return to in between excursions. On a recent October weekend, my friends and I—a total of six couples—found that combination at @schoonmakerretreat, tucked in the quaint Hudson Valley hamlet of High Falls.

The surrounding area seemed ripe for a fall weekend of vintage shopping, cider tasting, and lots of leaf-peeping. We lucked into a real Goldilocks window, with timing just right for trees to stand ablaze with reds, yellows, and the last bits of green. The weather was crisp, but still sunny enough to sit outside for hours, from long orchard lunches to cozy s’more nights."

Read about @jeschapel's full stay and book now at the link in bio.".
